meta.usage: One manifest per R<density><requirement> real-window family instance. Frozen BEFORE generation (ticket acceptance item 5). Every field under 'preregistration' is a design decision; editing it after a scenario has been generated is a prereg violation, exactly as for the M-family template.
meta.differs_from: scenario_manifest_template.json -- the M-family template's 300 s box retires here. Window width is a physical quantity computed from real orbit geometry, so there is no interval_width placeholder and no PASS_HORIZON.
meta.platform_orbit_is_required: The orbit is an input, not a default. generate_real_scenario raises rather than inventing one, so this template registers the orbit's provenance and the caller must supply matching elements.

scenario.window_semantics: real-orbit three-leg cascade: incidence mask n mode squint envelope n end-check

preregistration.cluster_assignment_rule: target i -> centre i % 8 (fixed order, no shuffle)

platform_orbit.provenance: design geometry: h=570 km, i=45 deg (platform_kim2021.json)
platform_orbit.note: supplied by the caller; the generator refuses to invent one

squint_semantics.t_ca_s: the ZERO of sss_core.geometry.squint_at -- drives the dwell closure and the AASR bandwidth
squint_semantics.vector_squint_min_t_s: the minimum of the forked VECTOR squint (realwindows.satellite_to_target_vector) -- the point the incidence mask is evaluated at
squint_semantics.why_two: These are different physical quantities with different zero points, measured: the vector minimum sits ~600 s away from the planar zero, and at closest approach they read 12.749 deg vs 0.000 deg on the same target. The mode-envelope leg consumes ONLY squint_at; the vector squint never enters an envelope test.

per_task_geometry_fields.r0_m: slant range at this task's incidence (look_geometry Eq.2-3)
per_task_geometry_fields.incidence_deg: incidence angle at the window centre
per_task_geometry_fields.vector_squint_min_t_s: vector-squint minimum within the incidence leg
per_task_geometry_fields.window_width_s: cascade width, a physical quantity in the M family

amendment_20261005_ticket25.status: ACTIVE -- supersedes the v1 fields above for generation; the frozen v1 fields are retained verbatim per append-only discipline
amendment_20261005_ticket25.trigger: ledger R22: the v1 pass rule (epoch + {0,600} s) is an arbitrary phase point, not a transit; measured 0/8 clusters servable under the ticket-24 incidence fix, 6/8 under true enumeration

family_registry.retired: R4H (N=500) -- AD-5: single-transit STR capacity 24 => ceil(N/24) passes; N>=150 exceeds the registered span. The v1 registry slot 4 and recompute_r_fam.py FAMILIES entry are removed together.

dense_domain.assignment_rule: target i -> node i % 25 (row-major), uniform jitter within own cell
dense_domain.servability_evidence: probe 2026-10-05: 25/25 nodes carry >=1 in-band transit in 72 h; gap-merge pass counts invariant across {150,300,600,1200} s on all nodes; centre node 2.00 transits/24h (registered value reproduced)
dense_domain.must5_criterion_note: v1 finding-A wording ('best incidence in [30,60]') is satisfied by the OPERATIVE criterion '>=1 in-band transit per node' (25/25). The literal min-over-span reading fails at the centre (21.7 deg: near-nadir passes exist there but simply yield no in-band window); registered so the criterion is falsifiable.

enumeration.gap_merge_status: registered band parameter (pass counts invariant across the range, probe-measured); NOT a physical lower bound
enumeration.t_ca_rule: vector-squint minimum of the pass segment = closest approach; may sit at a near-nadir point OUTSIDE the band (that is the planar model's anchor, not an in-band point)
enumeration.window_cascade: incidence runs n envelope n end-check n AASR, per window (AD-6: the incidence leg JOINS the intersection; every emitted window is four-leg clean)
enumeration.in_sim_ground_track_repeat: 14.97 orbits ~= 23.93 h (two-body propagator: no J2 nodal drift; the v1 '14.75 orbits' figure included J2 and applies to the physical orbit, not the simulated one)

window_schema.task_fields_removed: scalar t_ca_s / r0_m / incidence_deg / window_width_s / vector_squint_min_t_s (per-window now; a multi-window manifest keeping a scalar t_ca would silently mis-feed consumers)
window_schema.task_fields_kept: t_start_s / t_end_s (window-span scalars, used for ordering), azimuth_size_m, priority, rho_req_m, mode, prf_hz, lat_deg, lon_deg
window_schema.windows_entry: lo_s / hi_s / t_ca_s / r0_m / incidence_deg / width_s -- one entry per surviving cascade window, sorted by lo_s; r0_m is the pass's closest-approach range (the planar model's R0), incidence_deg is measured at the window midpoint
window_schema.consumer_contract: all squint/dwell/AASR consumers go through TaskPlan.t_ca_at(t) / window_at(t) (closed-interval lookup); the flattened feasible union keeps manifest window order (decode_tau measure-walk unchanged); 2N decision variables unchanged -- transit choice is implicit in tau

amendment_20261005_ticket25.squint_semantics_update: the v1 'two zero points' note is superseded for the R family: under enumeration each window's t_ca_s IS its pass's vector-squint minimum, so the planar zero and the vector minimum coincide by construction (the v1 separation existed because the old code picked in-band run midpoints). The mode-envelope leg still consumes ONLY sss_core.geometry.squint_at; the vector squint never enters an envelope test.
